newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Align-Rite Q4 EPS view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Align-Rite Q4 EPS view cut.

text.p: --EVEREN Securities Inc said Friday it reduced its 1997 fourth-quarter earnings per share estimate on Align-Rite International Inc to $0.28 from $0.32. It also cut the 1998 estimate to $1.30 from $1.41.
--The action primarily reflects a more conservative revenue growth rate assumption, EVEREN said in a report.
--It reiterated an outperform rating on the stock of the company, which manufactures photomasks.
